The Scheme of English-Taught Medical Undergraduate(6 years)
Bachelor of Medicine & Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS) Curriculum
1 Program Aim:
Referring to the international standard for medical education, the program of MBBS aims to educate international 
medical talents with solid medical knowledge, standard clinical skills and good professionalism while giving due 
consideration to the possible needs for them to serve in countries outside China. Students will acquire the capacity to work in 
medical and health institutions, making contributions to the areas of patient care, education and research.
The program includes 4 stages: the ﬁrst academic year is the stage of premedical study; the second and the third year are 
the stage of basic medical education, the forth and the ﬁfth year are the stage of clinical medical education; and the last year 
is for clinical internship. The program is completely taught in English and follows the principle of consolidating academic 
basis, stressing technical skills, enhancing inter-discipline and conducting clinical practices.
2 Credit and Degree:
The program requires students to complete 230.5 credits (at least 59 credits for practice) in total throughout six academic 
years (46 credits in premedical study and 184.5 credits in specialized course). Diploma will be conferred to those students 
who are successful in exam and the Bachelor of Medicine & Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS) will be granted to those who meet 
the requirements of the degree by Fudan University.
